name: OD groove, pecked
author: GlossCode
about: Plunges one tool-width groove at Z, pecking in X to break the chip. Each peck feeds in by PECK and backs out by BACK, and the next peck feeds in from there. It feeds back to the bottom, dwells, then rapids back out to STRT. X values are diameters.

args.name: STRT
args.desc: Diameter to start from, clear of the part

args.name: BOT
args.desc: Diameter at the bottom of the groove

args.name: ZPOS
args.desc: Z position of the groove (the tool's reference edge)

args.name: PECK
args.desc: How far in X each peck goes (on diameter)

args.name: BACK
args.desc: How far it backs out after each peck (on diameter)

args.name: DWL
args.desc: Seconds to dwell at the bottom
